editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: IG is the most heavily regulated retail broker in existence — 8 Tier-1 licences, FTSE 100 constituent, 51 years of continuous operation, and the cleanest regulatory record of any broker we have reviewed. NAFT scores IG 9.0 out of 10 in 2026, the highest trust score in our queue. FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 for UK clients, NFA/CFTC registration for US access, and 19,000+ instruments spanning CFDs, spread betting, shares, ISAs, SIPPs, and options make this a full-service investment platform rather than just a CFD broker. The 68% retail loss rate is the lowest in our queue — still majority losses, but better client outcomes than the industry norm. The honest trade-off: you pay more per trade. EUR/USD from 0.6 pips with no raw-spread commission account means active scalpers will find cheaper execution elsewhere. IG does not compete on cost. It competes on trust, product depth, and institutional-grade infrastructure — and on those metrics, nothing in the retail space comes close.
